records.title_zh: 四块不一定是四分之一
records.title_en: Four pieces do not automatically make fourths
records.purpose: Make equal partitioning part of the fraction definition.
records.use_when: Introducing fractions or correcting piece-counting errors.
records.setup: Show two shapes each divided into four regions: one equal, one unequal.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 两个图形都分成4块。涂1块都可以叫1/4吗？为什么？
records.teacher_prompt_en: Both shapes are split into four pieces. Does one shaded piece always represent 1/4? Why?
records.expected_thinking: Fourths require four equal parts of the same whole.

records.title_en: Treat the fraction as a number
records.purpose: Move from part-whole images to fraction magnitude.
records.use_when: When pupils can shade fractions but struggle to compare or locate them.
records.setup: Draw a number line from 0 to 1.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 把3/4标在数轴上。你先确定什么单位？为什么第三个分点就是3/4？
records.teacher_prompt_en: Place 3/4 on the number line. What unit did you establish first? Why does the third division point represent 3/4?
records.expected_thinking: 0-1 is divided into four equal intervals; 3/4 is three units of 1/4 from zero.
records.listen_for: Counting tick marks rather than intervals; unequal intervals.
records.variation: Extend the line beyond 1 and place 5/4.

records.use_when: Upper-primary fraction meaning or before fraction division/ratio.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 3个披萨平均分给4人，每人得到多少？为什么3÷4可以写成3/4？
records.teacher_prompt_en: Share 3 pizzas equally among 4 people. How much does each person receive? Why can 3÷4 be written as 3/4?
records.expected_thinking: Each person receives three one-fourth pieces, equal to 3/4; a fraction can represent a quotient.
records.listen_for: Dividing each pizza into four but reporting 1/4 rather than three quarters total.

records.purpose: Treat fractions as counts of a unit fraction.
records.use_when: Before equivalence, comparison or fraction operations.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 3/5的分数单位是什么？有几个这样的单位？7/5呢？
records.teacher_prompt_en: What is the fraction unit in 3/5? How many such units are there? What about 7/5?
records.expected_thinking: Both use 1/5 as the unit; 3/5 is three units and 7/5 is seven units.
records.listen_for: Naming 5 as the unit; treating numerator and denominator as separate labels.

records.purpose: Use interval structure rather than counting pre-drawn ticks.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 在这条数轴上标出2/3。你需要先做什么？为什么要分成3个相等区间而不是画3个刻度？
records.teacher_prompt_en: Place 2/3 on this number line. What must you do first? Why do you need three equal intervals rather than simply three tick marks?
records.expected_thinking: The unit interval is partitioned into three equal lengths; 2/3 is two such lengths from zero.
records.listen_for: Drawing three internal marks and creating four intervals; unequal spacing.
records.variation: Place 4/3 on a line extending to 2.

records.purpose: Explain equivalence as equal magnitude before using a symbolic rule.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 把1/2、2/4、4/8标在同一数轴上。为什么分子分母都变了，但表示的数没有变？
records.teacher_prompt_en: Place 1/2, 2/4 and 4/8 on the same number line. Why do the numerator and denominator change while the value stays the same?
records.expected_thinking: The unit is subdivided into smaller equal parts while the total distance from zero stays unchanged.
records.listen_for: Using 'multiply top and bottom' without explaining preserved quantity.
records.variation: Generate a fraction equivalent to 3/5 and justify it with a model.
